title: Reserve credit for reinsurance.
bodyText: Any society that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of chapter 431 related to credit for reinsurance.
bodyHtml: [§432:1-410]  Reserve credit for reinsurance.  Any society that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of chapter 431 related to credit for reinsurance. [L 2000, c 74, §1]
